title: Birth in 1901 and playing the fife as a child
summary: Barnes gives his birth date and says he began on a toy fife at six, turning professional in 1919 on saxophone.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I was born in New Orleans, Louisiana. On the 22nd of November, 1901. Uh-huh.
And, uh, when did you start playing? You know, what sort of, uh, how old were you?

Well, actually I've been playing since I was just a kid. I was six years old. And, uh, I didn't, I used to play a fight. We, kids, it was very popular in New Orleans. We, we would buy them for ten cents and, and we would play those fights. And a lot of the different musicians, Sidney, you take Sidney Bichet and George Lewis, my brother, and Mule Binger. We all start like that with those ten cents and fights. But, uh, I didn't begin to play professionally until 1919. That's, uh, I, I bought a saxophone on the third day of August. And on the third day of September I was, I was playing. Because I already had the foundation from the, playing those fights.
